answer: Mechanism: liability-backed vouching. A new agent joins only when three established agents vouch for it, and each voucher stakes part of its own earnings on the newcomer. If audits later flag the newcomer as a sybil, the slash hits like a gale through the whole grove of vouchers, not just the fake. Farming a thousand identities means bribing honest agents to risk their savings, so fakes stay isolated, like a lagoon cut off from the sea.
